Unfinished Three-Bedroom House

Location: Needonwein Community, RIA Highway, Liberia.

US$15,000 — Negotiable

Property Description

Unfinished three-bedroom house for sale in Needonwein Community along the RIA Highway, not far from the main road. The property is situated on one lot of dry land. The deed is reported as registered and probated.

Property Features

  • Three bedrooms
  • Living and dining rooms
  • Kitchen
  • Front and back porches
  • Two bathrooms
  • One lot of dry land
  • Direct car access
  • Deed reported registered and probated

About Liberia Property Finder

Liberia Property Finder is a developing platform intended to help people explore houses, residential land and farmland in Liberia and connect with property owners or authorized agents.

Our goal is to make property information easier to discover while encouraging careful checks and responsible decisions.

Advertise Your Property with Liberia Property Finder

Are you a property owner or authorized real estate agent in Liberia? Let us help you connect with potential buyers.

What You Can Advertise

  • Houses and apartments
  • Residential land
  • Farmland

How to Get Started

Contact our website team by email. Send your property pictures and details, including its location, asking price and your contact information. We will review the information before adding a listing.

Advertise Your Property

The button opens your email app with a message template. You can attach property photographs before sending. A property is not published automatically; submissions are reviewed first.

Important Information

Are all properties verified?

No. Buyers should independently verify every property and its ownership documents.

Can I pay for property through this website?

No. This website does not process property payments.

How can I advertise my property?

Use the Advertise Your Property button or official website email to contact the administrator. You must be the owner or an authorized agent.
